# Result adapter: the caller supplies only the real owner.  The two values
# awaited by the probation producer come exclusively from the signed fact.
# The producer call and its read-side ACK are deliberately separated by a
# hidden D+1 event; no value written by probation is read in this chain.

    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_status

        save_temporary_scope_value_as = {

                value = var:zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_attribution_bps_1
                add = var:zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_attribution_bps_2
                add = var:zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_attribution_bps_3
            }
        }
    }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_variable = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_consumed

        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_status value = 5 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_dispatch_committed value = 1 } # dispatch receipt commit marker is last
        zg361_workforce_probation_fact_publish_from_result_effect = {
            OWNER = $OWNER$
            ATTRIBUTION_BPS_2 = var:zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_attribution_bps_2
            ATTRIBUTION_BPS_3 = var:zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_attribution_bps_3
        }
        trigger_event = { id = zg361workforceattributionfact.3 days = 1 }

    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_status value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_red_code value = 26921 }
    }

# Route C creates a policy-debt receipt instead of a #269 outcome object.
# This adapter lets the central integration close the signed slot without
# pretending that probation consumed it.  Call only on a later event/frame
# after the debt manifest and its read-side visibility marker exist.
zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_cancel_from_m269_debt_effect = {
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_status
    remove_variable = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_red_code

        limit = { has_variable = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_cycle has_variable = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_case }

            value = {
                value = var:zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_cycle multiply = 1000000
                add = { value = var:zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_case multiply = 1000 }
                add = 269

            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_state value = 3 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_status value = 1 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_consumed value = 1 } # cancel/consume marker is last
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_status value = 4 }
            set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_red_code value = 26932 }
        }
    }
    else = {
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_status value = 4 }
        set_variable = { name = zg361_workforce_attribution_fact_red_code value = 26931 }
    }
}
